procedure_full_name: CT Scan of Head with Contrast

sections.heading: Page 1 Overview
sections.content:
Humana - Clinical Coverage Guideline
Spine CT 73ce01 (Version 2026.test_73ce01)

sections.heading: Coverage Scope
sections.content: This medical policy sets forth diagnostic criteria for outpatient computed tomography. Applicable CPT codes include

sections.heading: Clinical Indication
sections.content:
Patient must have documented neurological signs or symptoms, such as severe persistent headaches with atypical
features, dizziness, or visual disturbance.

sections.heading: Duration of Symptoms
sections.content: Symptoms must persist for at least 6 weeks of active outpatient care prior to imaging.

sections.heading: Previous Conservative Treatment
sections.content: A documented course of conservative therapy must be attempted without improvement.

sections.heading: Contrast Justification
sections.content: If intravenous contrast is requested, clinical rationale must establish suspicion of mass or neoplasm.
